description: Wave 7 Final Release Performance Gates — hard and soft guardrails for release sign-off.

hard_gates.description: Single-key read p99 must not exceed 200 µs.
hard_gates.rationale: Exceeding this threshold causes unacceptable OLTP tail latency under production load.
Below this rate, peak ingest SLAs cannot be met.

hard_gates.description: Range scan p99 must not exceed 500 µs (100-record window).
hard_gates.rationale: Range scan latency directly impacts analytics query response time.

hard_gates.description: Batch write (500 records) p99 must not exceed 5 ms.
hard_gates.rationale: Batch ingestion pipelines depend on bounded batch latency.

hard_gates.description: Guardrail self-check: p99 read gate counter must equal 1.0 (pass).
hard_gates.rationale: GVO-04 validates gate logic itself — must not regress.

hard_gates.description: Guardrail self-check: write throughput gate counter must equal 1.0 (pass).
hard_gates.rationale: GVO-05 validates gate logic itself — must not regress.

soft_gates.description: Read workload coefficient of variation should stay below 5%.
soft_gates.rationale: High CV indicates measurement noise that may mask real regressions.

soft_gates.description: Write workload coefficient of variation should stay below 8%.
soft_gates.rationale: Write CV is typically higher due to compaction; 8% is the acceptable ceiling.

soft_gates.description: Steady read throughput must not drift more than 10% across soak segments.
soft_gates.rationale: Drift beyond 10% signals memory leak, cache degradation, or background I/O growth.

soft_gates.description: ANN vector search p99 should stay below 200 µs.
soft_gates.rationale: Vector search latency is user-visible in semantic query paths.

soft_gates.description: Key sequence determinism must produce zero mismatches.
soft_gates.rationale: Non-deterministic key generation invalidates cross-run comparisons.

known_limitations: GVO-06 isolation model uses thread yield, not CPU affinity pinning; results may vary on shared CI runners.
W7B soak segments use Google Benchmark Iterations() which counts outer iterations, not inner ops — item counts are correctly set via SetItemsProcessed().
DFR-03 concurrency test uses std::thread without CPU affinity; results on NUMA systems may show wider variance.
Vector (RCS-06) and Graph (RCS-07) benchmarks depend on VectorIndex / GraphIndex stub implementations; results reflect stub latency until real backends are wired.
